label: prf:binding-closure-conditional
title: Proof of binding closure conditional on the per-term mass identity
html:
By obligation (C) (lem:bond-order-eq-jet-degree), the binding is the body-order series, B(K)=\sum_{n}\,(\text{\(n\)-body term}). By the conditional input (B), each body term factors as B_n = m_e\,a_D^{(n)}. Substituting and pulling the common scale m_e out of the (finite) sum,

B(K) \;=\; \sum_n B_n \;=\; \sum_n m_e\,a_D^{(n)} \;=\; m_e\sum_n a_D^{(n)} .

Rewriting each period through the residue form (prop:sw-period-residue-sum) gives the second displayed equality of the statement; the growth law of the a_D^{(n)} is the solution of the q-difference recurrence (prop:binding-genfun-qdifference). The Lean witness QOU.Mass.binding_closure_conditional carries (C) and (B) as the fields of the class BindingClosureInput and derives the closed form by Finset.mul_sum and Finset.sum_congr — fully verified modulo the class instance, which is exactly input (B). \qquad\blacksquare
